question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Extrusion
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Welcome)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extrusion"** refers to the act of forcing something out, especially in a mechanical or physical sense. It can also mean being pushed out or thrust out. (निकालना)

 
 
• **Example:** The machine is designed for the extrusion of plastic materials into pipes.
 
 
 
• **"Welcome"** is the antonym of extrusion as it signifies accepting, receiving, or inviting someone or something in, which is the opposite of pushing or forcing out. (स्वागत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** We warmly welcome all the new students to our university.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Welcome"** is the most appropriate antonym for **"Extrusion"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Welcome)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Banish** (निर्वासन): To send someone away as a punishment; to expel from a place.

 
 
• **Example:** The king decided to banish the traitor from the kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Exile** (निर्वासन): The state of being barred from one’s native country, typically for political or punitive reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** After the war, the leader lived in exile for many years.
 
 
 
• **Suspension** (निलंबन): The temporary prevention of something from continuing or being in force.
 
 
• **Example:** The suspension of the project caused a delay in its completion.
